tha-ap5:2.1: udaggacittā → “aggiṁ minantā janatā”ti samūho aggiṁ ādāhanatthāya minantā (bj: rāsi karontā” – aṭṭhakathā)
tha-ap5:2.4: udapajjatha → upapajjatha (bj, sya-all) | upapajjatha → udapajjatha (bj: machasaṁ, PTS)
tha-ap5:5.2: satahatthasamuggataṁ diyaḍḍhahatthapatthaṭaṁ → satahatthaṁ samuggataṁ diyaḍḍhaṁ hatthasataṁpi (sya-all)
tha-ap5:6.1: hammiyaṁ → agghiyaṁ (sya-all) | hammiyaṁ → agghiyaṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu)
tha-ap5:7.2: kiṁsuko iva → sālarājāva (bj) | sālarājā’va → kiṁsuko viya (bj: sī.selu) | iva → sālarājāva (cck: sī.)
tha-ap5:9.4: sattabhūmaṁ → sattabhummaṁ (sya-all) | sattabhūmaṁ → sattabhūmi (bj: PTS, sī.selu)
tha-ap5:10.2: ahuṁ → ahū (bj); ahu (sya-all) | sabbasoṇṇamayā → sabbe sovaṇṇayā (bj: PTS); sabbe (bj: the)
tha-ap5:12.4: disā dasa → disodisaṁ (sya-all) | dasa → disodisaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap5:14.4: pathaviṁ → paṭhaviṁ (bj, sya-all) | paṭhaviṁ → pathavyaṁ (bj: the)
tha-ap5:17.1: catubbīsaṁ → catubbīsā (sya-all) | catubbīsaṁ → catubbīsa (bj: machasaṁ, the, sī.selu)
tha-ap5:17.2: dvādasa rammaṇaṁ → dvādasaṁ rammakaṁ (bj); dvādasā rammakaṁ (sya-all) | dvādasaṁ → dvādasa (bj: sī.selu, machasaṁ, the); dvādasā (bj: PTS)
tha-ap5:19.4: ākiṇṇaṁ → ākiṇṇā (sya-all) | laṅkataṁ → satatā (sya-all) | tadā → hoti laṅkataṁ (bj: machasaṁ, the); laṅkato (bj: sī.selu) | laṅkataṁ → taṁ tadā (cck: sī.); satatā (cck: syā.); saṅkaraṁ (cck: ?)
tha-ap5:20.3: sadākiṇṇaṁ rammaṇaṁ → tadākiṇṇaṁ rammakaṁ (sya-all) | sadākiṇṇaṁ → tadākiṇṇaṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu)
tha-ap5:21.1: pivitvā → bhūtvā ca pītvā (bj: PTS); bhūtvā vasitvā ca (bj: sī.selu)
tha-ap5:21.2: devattanaṁ → devattataṁ (sya-all) | devattanaṁ → punapi devataṁ (bj: machasaṁ, the) | gato → punapi devataṅgato (cck: ka.)
tha-ap5:22.4: hiraññassāpi pabbajiṁ → hiraññassa paribbajiṁ (sya-all) | pabbajiṁ → paribbajiṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu)
